meta.name: design-blueprint
meta.description: Run a complete design workflow -- from establishing context through 5 progressive design levels to an approved blueprint. Composes context anchoring, design-first methodology, architecture, and DDD into a unified process. Handles both new features (create context doc) and resuming existing work (load context doc). Use when starting a design, planning architecture, or when the user says 'design a feature', 'blueprint', 'start designing', 'plan the architecture', or 'let's design before coding'.
